changelog: BobLimt v3.0.5: per-profile swap mode is now Vanilla/K3 (was Legacy/Updated). Vanilla is the original blind click-cycle timer; K3 is the pixel-confirmed swap-count engine from v3.0.4, with Advanced Loadout Delay and the Swap Counter HUD as K3-only options. Also fixed the Watch Point capture hint rendering past the window edge.
